symptom: S04_06 chorus-1 layup I2V became a rim-hang dunk by t50/t99. Hand grabbed the hoop.
root_cause: Prompt 'tracking with the layup' plus 'ball kisses glass' let H3 complete the scoring action as a dunk. Start still is already airborne near the rim.
fix: Lock body in finger-roll pose. Ball banks off glass. Explicit: shooting hand stays below the rim, never grabs, no hanging. Prefer locked tripod so he does not fly into the hoop.
prevention: Chorus-1 S04_06: never say dunk, hang, rim grab, or tracking into the hoop. QA t50/t99 hand-rim gap. Last dunk only at S07_03.
